name: Chuzhoj dom
source: The earthly world and the otherworldly world are eerily intertwined in the mind of the protagonist of this story. Which of the worlds is the real one? Not only the fate of the main character will depend on the choice made, but also, perhaps, the fate of both worlds.
translation: The earthly world and the otherworldly world are eerily intertwined in the mind of the protagonist of this story. Which of the worlds is the real one? Not only the fate of the main character will depend on the choice made, but also, perhaps, the fate of both worlds.
